weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a soft lid of cloud, the light turned down to a calm, pewter glow. The sun keeps its distance; UV is muted under the overcast, gentle to modest around midday but not gone altogether. Expect the cloud to linger through the late morning into afternoon, a gray, steady backdrop that smooths the edges of things. Visibility stays clean but the day lacks sparkle, more matte than glossy.

It’s a pleasantly subdued sort of weather: easy on the eyes, good for unhurried plans. Dress in light layers—long sleeves and a cardigan or a light jacket will feel right—and save the heavy sun gear, though a touch of sunscreen won’t hurt if you linger outside at lunch. This is a day for practical comforts: a coffee run and a short wander to the bookshop, a quiet browse through a gallery, or a steady loop through Kings Park’s paths without chasing views. Tackle a few errands, tidy a corner of the house, or settle into work at a café window while the sky holds its steady gray note.
